answer: A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The wander counter is kept in orchard and mirror shows each reset. Anyone as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 905 identities would post 4677 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
